title: Title tiles play, and a few knobs restyle a title
goal: Browsing titles shows them moving: a tile plays its animation when the pointer is over it and loops while it is picked. Once a title is in, a short set of knobs restyles the whole thing at once (colour theme, font pair, energy, intensity, background) before anyone needs to touch its parts one by one.
notes: User's words (2026-10-10): "the comps in the library for titles are so very bland. They look like powerpoint titles. I am wondering if we can have more professionally polished animated title screens with interesting, tweakable effects. Moving backgrounds, text that comes in, looks polished and designed, maybe motion blur, not like a template. do research on what good looking intros look like and derive how to make it easy to build these." The research and the model are in docs/design/video-titles-polish.md (READ IT FIRST: techniques, twelve style recipes, the TitleDesign/TitlePart/behaviour model that compiles to keys, renderer costs, today's gaps with file refs). Six tasks build it in order: titles-move-in-parts, title-text-by-line-word-letter, title-backgrounds-move, motion-blur-on-titles, title-tiles-play-and-knobs, a-set-of-titles-that-look-designed. This is step 5 of 6.
acceptance: Library title tiles animate on hover and loop while picked, at small size, using the person's own recording frame behind them where the style uses the recording; clicking a tile still highlights it within one frame (see clicking-a-title-in-the-library-highlights-it-at)

A Title section in the panel for a picked title, in this order: Theme (swatches plus From Recording, which samples two or three colours from the clip), Font pair (four or five curated pairs), Energy (Calm, Normal, Punchy scaling durations x1.3, x1, x0.7 and overshoot, stagger and motion blur with it), Intensity (one slider for blur, distance, grain and glow), Background (on or off and its kind); placement checked against the IA contract in docs/design/mocks/shared/UX-PATTERNS.md, anything uncovered goes to a decision card
Picking a part of the title (on the canvas or in the panel) shows its in, hold and out behaviour pickers with their few knobs and a Replay button; keys and the curve editor stay available
Typing on the canvas re-lays out the title and replays its in after a short pause
Save as My Title stores the design (behaviours, theme, roles), not only baked layers, so theme and energy stay changeable on a saved title
A walk changes theme, font pair and energy on a title and photographs each
Audit under queue/audits/; anything left rough is filed as a follow-up task if it clears the follow-up bar (queue/bin/follow-up-bar.md), and written into this task's log if it does not.

log.note: From step 1 (titles-move-in-parts): the model is TitleDesign / TitlePart / TitleBuild / TitleHold in Sources/PhotonzCore/TitleDesign.swift; BuiltInTitle.design holds each preset's choreography; applyTitleDesign compiles it into keys on the group's children. Nothing in the panel edits a part's in, hold or out yet, and the title's own bar carries no key diamonds (the keys are on its parts). A part's rows on the timeline open only while that part is picked (EditorState+Tracks timelineTrackRows). titleArrivalMS(layerID:) is the moment a title has finished arriving (playhead after insert, Library tile picture).

from step 3: the new Behind Glass page's Library tile is a dark page with words, because a tile is a still of the preset alone and its background is the recording under it; this task's 'own first frame behind them' is what fixes it. Aurora's tile is a still too, so its drift and grain do not show until it plays.

Review before building: no mock draws these sections, so the panel's own controls were used; a Premiere/FCP person expects title restyling in the inspector (Essential Graphics, Motion's published parameters), which is where it is. The model could not deliver the knobs as asked: a placed title kept no design, so the group now keeps a recipe and every knob recompiles it (old keys stripped first, so changing a part's in never leaves stale keys). Glass over nothing would be a dim nothing, so Glass is only offered with a picture under the title.

Built: PhotonzCore/TitleRestyle.swift (TitleTheme, TitleFontPair, TitleEnergy, TitleBackgroundKind, TitleRecipe on GroupContent.titleRecipe, restyleTitle, relayOutTitle, legibility pass), TitleDesign.clearTitleDesign, TitlePreset.reel and recording backdrop (TitlePresetShelf.swift); app: EditorState+TitleRestyle.swift, TitleRestyleInspector.swift (Title + Part sections), LibraryTitleTile plays via VideoKit.LoopingFrames, commitTextEdit relays out a title in the same step and replays after 450 ms, Replay Title on the clip's right-click and in Clip. Flag next-title-restyle on in Next. TimePanelOrder: keys, title, titlePart, speed, text, reveal.

Review after building, on the probe: the swatch strip first made the whole panel 4-5 pt wider than its column (every dropdown below scrolled sideways); swatches shrunk to fit ten across. A bare onHover was unreachable by walks (and a test forbids it): now playtestHover. Energy reads clearly at the same 0.4 s (Punchy landed, Calm still faint). title-words-mask-reveal-walk now brings the Reveal header into reach first, since the Part section above pushes Reveal down and a minimal scroll parked its dropdown under the title bar's panel toggle.

left rough (not filed): the Part section is long for one part (about 14 rows); dark words keep a light halo from the typed title's shadow (step 6 owns preset looks); titles placed before this carry no recipe and show no Title section; From Recording and the replay after typing are not walked yet. Replay as a panel verb is covered by the open card the-panel-shows-what-the-picked-thing-is-and-its-how-many-buttons-may-the-right-h. A panel dropdown scrolled to the very top can sit under the title bar's panel toggle (harness press refused it); pre-existing layout, seen only by a walk, so written here rather than filed.

Verified: TitleRestyleTests 17 (+ reel and recording tests), TimePanelOrderTests, EveryDropdownIsClickedByAWalk, FlagDescriptionBudget; full suite hung in HEIF/Vision (logged on find-out-why-the-whole-test-run-hangs-in-the-mac), split runs green: 11172 + 1185 + 66.
